subject: QBR: Roadmap bridge & launch coverage — alignment and mitigation plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR: Roadmap bridge & launch coverage — alignment and mitigation plan

Team —

As we prep the QBR (next Tues), we need a short decision thread on the roadmap bridge for the late-May launch. Two items have bumped risk profiles in the last sprint:

- Realtime routing (services/router): blocked on an infra-side socket pooling bug; impacts 95th p99 latency for multi-tenant bursts.
- KV-cache eviction policy change: improves throughput but risks cold-start regressions for some legacy workflows.

Quick proposal to keep launch window intact:
- Freeze non-critical UX polish (scope out ~8pts).
- Assign an "incident slice" (2 SRE / 2 infra engs) to unblock Realtime routing with a 5-day focused window.
- Roll KV eviction change behind a canary (10% of traffic) + short rollback window.

Attachments: launch_risk_matrix.xlsx (current risk matrix) and canary_playbook.pdf (draft).

Asks: please reply with the following by EOD 2027-04-23 so we can present a single slide to Execs:
1) Approve scope freeze? (yes/no)
2) Confirm owners for the incident slice (names) and ETA to unblock Realtime routing.
3) Any customer impact concerns we need to surface to Acme?

Thanks — short and specific please. I will collate and send a decision log.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

---
Attachments: launch_risk_matrix.xlsx (14 KB), canary_playbook.pdf (220 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Roadmap bridge & launch coverage — alignment and mitigation plan

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> As we prep the QBR (next Tues), we need a short decision thread on the roadmap bridge for the late-May launch. Two items have bumped risk profiles in the last sprint:
>
> - Realtime routing (services/router): blocked on an infra-side socket pooling bug; impacts 95th p99 latency for multi-tenant bursts.
> - KV-cache eviction policy change: improves throughput but risks cold-start regressions for some legacy workflows.

Agree with the proposed path. Quick status:
- Realtime routing: infra traced issue to socket reuse on GKE layer; engineering estimate 3-5 business days if we prioritize. I'll put Priya and Anil on a focused slice starting tomorrow if we have approval.
- KV eviction: backend change is backwards-compatible but we need a telemetry flag to monitor cold-starts — that's a ~2 day work item for eng.

Scope freeze: yes from my side. We should also consider descope of the experimental telemetry dashboard (low user value) to free 1 eng.

Owners: Karthik (coord), Priya N. (infra lead), Anil S. (runtime), Tessa (CS liaison to Acme). ETA to unblock Realtime routing: 3 business days if incident slice starts 4/23.

Karthik
Director, Engineering

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Roadmap bridge & launch coverage — alignment and mitigation plan

Thanks for the clear ask, Soojin.

I support the proposed freeze and focused incident slice — we need a defensible customer message if the canary shows risk. A few notes:

- Quantify customer impact: Tessa, can you confirm which Acme features rely on the KV eviction path? I want a short paragraph we can include in the QBR slide.
- Weekend on-call: approve a 48-hour on-call rotation for the incident slice around the planned unblock window. Compensate via on-call credit.
- Exec ask: give me two bullets on the rollback trigger (metric threshold + error spike).

Please capture decisions in the decision log; I'll sign off once we have the ETA and owners.

Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Decision log: Bridge plan approved — owners, ETAs, and next steps

Team / Sarah —

Summary of decisions and actions (for QBR slide and runbook):

Decisions made:
- Approve scope freeze for non-critical UX polish: YES (reduces scope ~8pts).
- Approve focused incident slice to unblock Realtime routing: YES.
- Roll KV eviction change behind 10% canary with rollback window: YES.

Owners & ETAs:
- Incident slice (Realtime routing): Priya N. (infra) & Anil S. (runtime) — unblock ETA: 2027-04-27 COB. Coordinator: Karthik Iyer.
- KV eviction canary: Anil S. + telemetry flag by 2027-04-26 EOD. Monitoring dashboard: Node + canary metrics (JIRA-ENG-4821).
- CS/customer comms: Tessa Morgan to draft a 1-paragraph impact note for Acme by 2027-04-25 12:00 PDT.
- On-call plan: Weekend rotation approved for incident slice (4/24–4/28).

Attachments included: launch_risk_matrix.xlsx, canary_playbook.pdf. Drive board: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D_example. JIRA: JIRA-ENG-4821.

Sarah — we will share the customer note once Tessa completes it (ETA above). If Acme needs a separate readout we can schedule a 30-min sync next week.

Action items (owner - due):
- Karthik: confirm Priya/Anil allocation and start slice 4/23. (Due: 2027-04-23 EOD)
- Tessa: customer impact paragraph for Acme. (Due: 2027-04-25 12:00 PDT)
- Anil: telemetry flag + canary rollout steps. (Due: 2027-04-26 EOD)
- Soojin: prepare QBR slide and decision log. (Due: 2027-04-26 09:00 PDT)

I'll upload a one-slide summary to the QBR folder and circulate to Execs after 4/26.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
